entities.name: Champion's Trial
entities.description: Final book of the second Legends cycle, by Scott McGough.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Former imperial champion who seeks vengeance on Overdark and Nicol Bolas and kills both.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Imperial regent appointed by Nicol Bolas, killed by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon emperor of Madara and planeswalker, killed by Tetsuo on the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Ally of Tetsuo who levels Overdark's keep and becomes a seventh circle master.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: A cat-dragon training Tetsuo, with five kittens, who routs the Kentsu legion.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Woman who became avatar of the Sylvan Library forest and turned from breaking artifacts to making forests.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: Once under Halfdane in the guise of Barktooth Warbeard, he joins Ayesha against him.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: A shapeshifter posing as the Kentsu commander Barktooth Warbeard, killed by Tor.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: A berserker Kentsu commander killed by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Army occupying Kusho and ravaging Argenti.

entities.name: Sergeant Chada
entities.description: Sole survivor of Ayesha's troops against the Sylvan Library.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Leader of the Edemis on Argenti who demands reparations from Madara.

entities.name: Lord Magnus
entities.description: Former avatar of the forest, who lets Ayesha go.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Murdered friend whom Ayesha wants to avenge.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: An enemy of Tetsuo who attacks Hatoki and is killed by him.

entities.name: Hatoki
entities.description: Tetsuo's standard-bearer.

entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: Character receiving medical treatment in a cave.

entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: Island ravaged by the Kentsu.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Island occupied by the Kentsu and poisoned by black mana.

entities.name: Sekana
entities.description: Island where Tetsuo's friends hide and later reunite.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Forest where Ayesha resides as avatar.

entities.name: Imperial Shrine
entities.description: Focal point of blue, black and red mana where Overdark resides; obliterated by Hage's hammer.

entities.name: Umezawa Manor
entities.description: Tetsuo's family manor.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: Plane to which Tetsuo flees and where he kills Bolas.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: The empire ruled by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Edemis
entities.description: People in uproar demanding reparations from Madara.

entities.name: Ærathi
entities.description: Group within the empire seeking to fill the power void.

events.summary: On Argenti Hage learns Ayesha became the forest's avatar and killed all Kentsu there; Overdark rescues Hage.
events.quote: Just before he is about to die, Hage is saved by Overdark

events.summary: Meha and the kittens destroy Kentsu forces sent to lure Tetsuo; Bolas robs Overdark of his body in punishment.
events.quote: Bolas robs Overdark of the use of his body

events.summary: Tetsuo saves Hatoki from Xira Arien, tracks her down and kills her.
events.quote: Tetsuo tracks her down, kills her, and blasts her body into a crater of molten glass.

events.summary: Ayesha and the grown coral reefs force the Kentsu to leave Kusho.
Ayesha cures Kusho of black mana poison and goes with Tor to seek Halfdane.
events.quote: Ayesha uses a seed she got from Magnus to cure the black mana poisoning on Kusho

events.summary: Wasitora routs the legion sent to level Umezawa Manor.
events.quote: that group is intercepted and routed by Wasitora

events.summary: Meha levels Overdark's keep and becomes a seventh circle master, cutting Overdark off from his mana.
events.quote: Overdark is now cut off from his main mana source.

events.summary: Tetsuo levels the Kentsu at the shrine with a meteor storm and kills Hage.
events.quote: Only the black-mana-infused Jorgan Hage survives but is killed by Tetsuo's sword.

events.summary: Ayesha traps Halfdane in a frozen pond and Tor destroys him with a black spell.
events.quote: Tor casts a black spell to destroy the shapeshifter.

events.summary: Tetsuo kills Overdark in the Imperial Shrine after Bolas's spell is deflected onto him.
events.quote: Tetsuo strikes first and kills Overdark.

events.summary: Tetsuo draws Bolas to the Meditation Plane, destroys the shrine with Hage's hammer, and kills Bolas.
Weeks later the friends reunite on Sekana and convince Tetsuo to restore order to the empire.
events.quote: he sets off to do just that

relations.quote: Tetsuo strikes first and kills Overdark.
Tetsuo tracks her down, kills her

relations.note: Made imperial regent by the emperor
relations.quote: Ramses Overdark has been made imperial regent by emperor Nicol Bolas .

relations.note: Tor served under Halfdane in disguise
relations.quote: Tor Wauki still serves under the shapeshifter Halfdane
has been training with Wasitora for some time
